name: B10-0375/2025 (PfE) – Situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the recent wave of terrorist attacks in Colombia and the killing of opposition senator and presidential candidate Miguel Uribe Turbay. It blames President Gustavo Petro's "total peace" policy for making things worse and says his government has been too soft on armed groups and drug cartels. It calls on Colombia to catch those responsible and on the European Union to declare the Venezuelan Cártel de los Soles a terrorist organisation. It also asks the European Commission to check that EU money sent to Colombia has not helped criminal or terrorist groups.

- The EU is asked to label the Cártel de los Soles a terrorist group; this affects Venezuela's rulers and EU countries.
- The European Commission must review EU funding to Colombia; this affects how European taxpayers' money is spent there.
- Colombia's government is urged to pursue and prosecute the killers and confront armed groups; this affects Colombian authorities and citizens.
